authorization: User: Measure rank; separate additive follow-up, original coverage records and protocol unchanged.
scope: All 88 distinct Solinas field/curve pairs, all degree-3 controls (157 distinct NF pairs total), and all 335 distinct rational curves from the original campaign. Higher-degree random/tdc controls are outside this follow-up scope.
identity: Deduplicate only exact defining polynomial and integer A,B. No field-isomorphism or curve-isomorphism deduplication; retain original cell mapping.
rank_method: PARI Q baselines reused from predecessor. Pinned Simon descent with exact local positive witnesses and explicit failure on unresolved large-prime tests. All base class/unit data certified. Degree-3 auxiliary data certified; higher-degree auxiliary class/unit data retain the GRH assumption unless explicitly certified in a separate later record. Both Sha parity uplifts disabled.
lower_bound: Take maximum of descent lower bound and certified rational lower bound; an extension cannot decrease rank.

degree_7_8_12.reason: Enumerating full coefficient boxes costs (2*lim+1)^degree. Initial pass computes exact Selmer bounds with supplied rational points; unresolved bounds remain unresolved.

resources.watchdog_interpretation: Protect this interactive campaign from unresponsive symbolic stages and explosive coefficient searches; retain every unfinished job as unresolved, never as rank zero. This is not a budget stop or negative mathematical result.

claim_policy: Degree-3 equal certified bounds are tool-exact. Higher-degree bounds are GRH-conditional when any auxiliary class/unit data remain uncertified. No independent review, hypothesis promotion, or ECDLP claim.
large_prime_local_policy: LIMBIGPRIME=31, MAXPROB=100. Exact enumeration only if p==2 or p<31 and norm<=1,000,000. The big-prime routine can only return true with an exact square witness; its final negative return is replaced by an error. An unresolved test produces no bound, avoiding probabilistic Selmer upper bounds.
